newsitem.title: UK: Four injured after UK train derails.
newsitem.headline: Four injured after UK train derails.

text.p: Four people were injured on Tuesday when a derailed freight train fell through a rail bridge onto workshops in southeast London, rescue officials said.
A London Fire Brigade spokesman said the train collapsed onto five railway arches that housed the workshops in the suburb of Bexley.

Rescue officials originally feared that up to 20 people were trapped under the crashed train but the spokesman said: "All the railway arches have been searched and everyone has now been accounted for."
"Eight people were taken to hospital but only four were injured," the spokesman added.
Six fire engines and 40 firefighters rushed to the crash scene and started combing the arches which had been converted into ndustrial units.
Rail officials warned that the crash would cause severe disruption as it happened on a busy commuter line into the British capital.
